# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 81 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 81 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_081_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Chapter 4

**1** "And those who returned their rods two-thirds green and one-third withered — who are they?" I asked. He answered, "These are those who were faithful but some of them denied and are now repentant. **2** And they shall live, for their repentance is genuine, and they shall not die. But those who denied and did not repent — these shall die. **3** And those who returned their rods with two-thirds withered and one-third green — who are these?" **4** He said, "These are those who believed but for the most part were double-minded and many of them were rich and had dealings with the world; and because of this they became faithless and served not God, for they put worldly business first. But they never departed from God — they always had a portion of faith in them, though small." **5** "And those who returned their rods with a small part green and almost all withered — who are they? They were double-minded and full of doubt; their works were evil. **6** "Now these," he said, "who returned their rods entirely withered and moth-eaten — these are those who denied the Lord and never returned to the faith. **7** And those who returned their rods with very little green and the rest withered — these are they who hear the word of God and believe but do not cleave to the Lord with their whole heart and do not work righteousness. They have neither departed from God nor acted righteously." **8** "Lord," I asked, "who is it then who is worthy to inhabit the tower?" "These only," he said, "who have returned their rods completely green, those who did not separate themselves from the living God, those who were faithful and who did not mingle with the world but remained unspotted, righteous in all their deeds."

---

*EMET renders "double-minded" (dipsuchos) as the precise technical term throughout the Shepherd. "Unspotted" renders aspiloi.*
